periods.time: Two years before vol-02, rainy season

name.en: Kuraudo Defeats Kaito and Takes the Ayatsuji Dojo

periods.summary: Kuraudo forces Kaito into a wager duel, defeats him with overwhelming reflexes, and wins the Ayatsuji dojo, leaving Kaito comatose.
periods.cause: Kuraudo wants to boast his strength against the Last Samurai; when Kaito refuses a gambling-like private duel, Kuraudo ambushes and breaks the disciples to force acceptance.
periods.process: Kaito accepts under rules of wood swords and no magic. He scores once through superior technique, but Kuraudo's impossible reflexes let him alter attacks and overwhelm Kaito. Though injured and dying, Kaito continues, attempting Ten'i Muhou before Kuraudo's final blow crushes him.
periods.outcome: Kuraudo wins the dojo and orders Ayase's side to leave; Kaito falls into a two-year coma while repeatedly murmuring apologies.
periods.aftermath: Ayase misinterprets the apology as regret toward her and dedicates herself to reclaiming the dojo via Seven Stars.
casualties: Kaito suffers catastrophic injuries and coma
Ayatsuji disciples are injured and emotionally broken
periods.significance: The core trauma behind Ayase's arc and the origin of Kuraudo's fixation on seeing Ten'i Muhou completed.
